+title: The default agent is never model-visible and never a slash command
+---
+The agent `default` (root AGENT.md of a local layer, or agents/default/AGENT.md of a layer) is the main session of the host. It must never be in `list agents`, `find agents` or the tool description, `start agent default` must give the unknown-agent corrective, and it must not be a slash command, whatever its frontmatter says. Otherwise the main session can delegate to a copy of itself.
